Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline (11:59 p.m.): October 5, 2026. Registration closed at 11:59 p.m. on October 5 for this election.
  • Early voting: October 7, 2026 to October 30, 2026. Early ballots are mailed and in-person early voting starts October 7. Hours and locations vary by county.
  • Last day to request a mail ballot: October 23, 2026. Ask your county election office for a one-time mail ballot. Ballots must be received by 7 p.m. on Election Day. Mail yours back by October 27, or return it in person.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

State

Governor and Lieutenant Governor

Four-year term. Incumbent Katie Hobbs is running for re-election. This is Arizona's first joint ticket for governor and lieutenant governor. Running mates: John Giles (Hobbs), Sine Kerr (Biggs), Lisa Castillo (Lombardo), Angela Harrolle Mohan (Hourihan).
